on the subjects. They ran many laboratory tests,

to confirm that it was safe. From 1934 to 1935,
they conducted their first field test with 1,592
children. In the group of 712 ⓒ[vaccinating /
vaccinated] children, only four developed whooping
cough, and none of these cases were serious.
Despite the apparent (A)[failure / success] of the

determined to (B)[expand / suspend] their research and
run more tests with larger groups of children. However,
they were (C)[able / unable] to proceed because they
were facing a severe lack of funds. With thousands of
children continuing to suffer from the disease, they
found themselves in a desperate situation.

(B)[decline / increase] in whooping cough infections.

Pearl Kendrick studied bacteriology in university and
ⓐwas recruited by the Michigan Department of
Health in 1920. It was there ⓑthat she met fellow
bacteriologist Grace Eldering. The two quickly bonded,
and in 1932 they started working (A)[together /
separately] on a vaccine for whooping cough.
Personal experience served as motivation for both of
them, as they had each survived whooping cough as
children ⓒitself and (B)[forgot / remembered] the
severe pain of the disease. Both scientists were also
eager to promote children’s health.
Unfortunately, research funding was extremely
limited due to the Great Depression. Also, Kendrick
and Eldering had to develop the vaccine as a
(C)[main / side] project. It was like having a second
job for ⓓwhich they never received any payment.
Still, when they finished their normal duties each
day, they would get started on the work that they
were enthusiastic about. The difficulties they faced
did not stop them from persisting toward their
goal. They did not do the work to make extra
money; instead, they worked ⓔto relieve the
suffering of innocent children and their families.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓘ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?

2개
3개

solution:
어법상 어색한 것은 총 3개이다.
ⓔ were written → was written (‘전치사+관계대명사’인 on which 뒤에서 주어와 동사가 도치된 구조이며, 뒤에 이어지는 주어가 카드에 적힌 문구 하나이므로 단수동사 was로 고친다.)
ⓕ let → to let (‘tell+목적어+to부정사’(~에게 …하라고 말하다) 구조이므로, 목적어 the servant 뒤에 목적격보어로 to let을 쓴다.)
ⓗ sealing → sealed (수식 대상인 envelope가 ‘봉해진’ 대상이므로, 능동의 의미를 나타내는 현재분사 sealing을 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 sealed로 고친다.)
오답
ⓐ 주어 he가 옷을 ‘입은 상태’를 나타내므로 dressed는 적절하다.
ⓑ keep의 목적어로 쓰인 동명사 smiling과 등위접속사 and로 병렬을 이루므로 rubbing은 적절하다.
ⓒ는 형용사 interested 뒤에서 '~하고 싶어 하는'의 의미를 완성하는 to부정사이므로 to know가 쓰인 것은 어법상 적절하다.
ⓓ 주어 The best thing I can do에 동사 do가 포함되어 있어 주격보어 자리의 to부정사에서 to를 생략할 수 있으므로 원형부정사 go가 쓰인 것은 어법상 적절하다.
ⓖ 전치사 of의 목적어 자리이므로 동명사 addressing이 쓰인 것은 어법상 적절하다.
ⓘ 장소를 나타내는 Inside가 앞에 놓이면서 주어와 동사가 도치되었으며, 주어 a check가 단수이므로 was는 적절하다.

solution:
